key_rationale: With headline CPI at 4.85% and core inflation significantly lower at 3.25%, the real policy rate is now comfortably in positive territory, supporting a shift to a neutral stance. Given the output gap is near zero and food inflation of 8.52% is largely supply-driven, maintaining the repo rate at 6.50% balances the need to anchor inflation expectations while avoiding excessive tightening that could hinder the ongoing growth recovery.
